test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

He tried to sing the anthem, but it was ___________ epic fail.
solution:
The correct answer is '**an**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct article to use before the word "**epic**" is "**an**" because "epic" begins with a vowel sound.
 
• Using "**an**" ensures the sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 3 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He tried to sing the anthem, but it was **an**__ epic fail."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No article"** is incorrect because an article is needed before the noun phrase "epic fail."
 
• **Option 2: "a"** is incorrect because "a" is used before words that begin with a consonant sound, and "epic" begins with a vowel sound.
 
• **Option 3: "the"** is incorrect because "the" is used to refer to something specific, and in this context, "an" is the appropriate article to use.
